points.description: First privileged action correctly named and explained: e.g. writing to CR3 (page directory pointer, changing address translation), writing to EFLAGS (changing execution status such as interrupt enable/disable), writing to IDTR (changing location of the IDT), or accessing a kernel-range virtual address. Must say what the action does/affects.
points.partial_credit: Half if the action is correctly named but not explained (or explanation is vague).

points.description: Second, different privileged action from the accepted list (CR3 write, EFLAGS write, IDTR write, access to kernel virtual address range), named and explained as above.
points.partial_credit: Half if the action is correctly named but not explained (or explanation is vague).

rubric.notes: Full marks need two distinct valid privileged actions, each named and briefly explained; clear synonyms are fine (e.g. "change page table base register", "disable interrupts"). Give part marks for a correct action with no or vague explanation. Give no marks for OS-side items the user process cannot attempt directly (e.g. updating the PCB), or generic answers like "access hardware" with no specifics. Duplicates of the same action count once.
